title: S&P 500 options are the hottest bet on this Hyperliquid exchange
summary: Hypercall, an exchange built on Hyperliquid, says most of its $640 million in volume since June has come from the index.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles from near $84,000 ahead of U.S. inflation data
summary: A brief run at $84,000 faded within the hour as tech stocks stalled and the chip selloff rolled on. Traders are waiting on the September CPI print.

title: Proposed French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
summary: Chainalysis CEO in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
summary: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.

title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
summary: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.
